content:
[L] high | top-left header region | "Sync Health" title and subtitle are clipped at the left window edge, cutting off the first characters.
[L] high | action bar | "Cancel running sync" button bleeds off the right window edge with zero right margin.
[L] high | "Run initial sync" button | button is flush against the left window edge with no inset, unlike neighboring buttons which have gaps.
[S] med | header vs body | header block uses a different inset than the "LIVE" banner below, edges don't align to a shared grid.
[S] med | Engine card region | Engine card is narrow and floats with a large empty gray dead zone to its right; other cards span full width — inconsistent card widths.
[S] med | Checkpoints table | status column values ("ok", "retrying", "failed") are not aligned with their uppercase column header position consistency; numeric columns are right-aligned but header text left-aligned creating mismatch.
[S] med | Recent runs table | ID column values (1, 2) right-aligned while ID header is far-left aligned — massive misalignment.
[S] low | action buttons | three "Run" buttons have inconsistent spacing vs the far-flung red cancel button; no grouping or separation logic.
[H] high | page header vs "LIVE" | giant "LIVE" text at same weight as title "Sync Health" — competing headings, unclear hierarchy; also "LIVE" appears three times (banner, badge, table state) at different sizes.
[H] med | Checkpoints table | monospace body text mixed with sans-serif labels/headers — inconsistent typography within one table.
[H] med | Engine card | queue metrics ("5 total · 1 pending · …") crammed into one low-contrast run-on line, indistinguishable label/value weighting.
[C] high | bottom half of window | roughly 40% of the screen is empty black/gray dead space while tables sit crushed at top — severely unbalanced composition.
[C] med | Engine card | single card treatment (white on gray) differs from the two table cards' treatment (white on white with borders) — inconsistent card system.
[C] med | "Cancel running sync" red destructive button | destructive action given equal prominence and remote placement with no context of what it cancels — reads as debug-toolbar affordance.
[C] low | Checkpoints header | "Checkpoints" and "Recent runs" section titles have no icons, counts, or grouping cues, floating alone above tables.

VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped title, edge-bleeding controls, a half-empty dead bottom half, and inconsistent typography/table alignment throughout mark this as an unfinished debug screen, not a product.
